description: This file contains validation functions for Kubernetes resource names, IP addresses, ports, labels, and other configuration parameters, including regex patterns and validation logic.

methods.name: IsQualifiedName
methods.description: Checks if a string is a Kubernetes qualified name, possibly with a DNS subdomain prefix.

methods.name: IsFullyQualifiedName
methods.description: Checks if a string is a fully qualified name with at least three domain segments.

methods.name: IsFullyQualifiedDomainName
methods.description: Checks if a string is a fully qualified domain name with at least two segments, allowing a trailing dot.

methods.name: IsDomainPrefixedPath
methods.description: Validates if a string is a domain-prefixed path, with a valid DNS subdomain and HTTP path.

methods.name: IsValidLabelValue
methods.description: Validates if a string is a valid Kubernetes label value.

methods.name: IsDNS1123Label
methods.description: Checks if a string conforms to DNS-1123 label format.

methods.name: IsDNS1123Subdomain
methods.description: Checks if a string conforms to DNS-1123 subdomain format.

methods.name: IsDNS1035Label
methods.description: Checks if a string conforms to DNS-1035 label format.

methods.name: IsWildcardDNS1123Subdomain
methods.description: Checks if a string is a wildcard DNS-1123 subdomain.

methods.name: IsCIdentifier
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid C language identifier.

methods.name: IsValidPortNum
methods.description: Validates if an integer is a valid TCP/UDP port number.

methods.name: IsInRange
methods.description: Checks if an integer is within a specified inclusive range.

methods.name: IsValidGroupID
methods.description: Validates if a GID is within valid Unix UID/GID limits.

methods.name: IsValidUserID
methods.description: Validates if a UID is within valid Unix UID/GID limits.

methods.name: IsValidPortName
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid port name according to RFC 6335.

methods.name: IsValidIP
methods.description: Validates if a string is a valid IP address.

methods.name: IsValidIPv4Address
methods.description: Validates if a string is a valid IPv4 address.

methods.name: IsValidIPv6Address
methods.description: Validates if a string is a valid IPv6 address.

methods.name: IsValidPercent
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid percentage format.

methods.name: IsHTTPHeaderName
methods.description: Validates if a string conforms to HTTP header field name rules.

methods.name: IsEnvVarName
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid environment variable name.

methods.name: IsConfigMapKey
methods.description: Validates if a string is a valid ConfigMap or Secret key.

methods.name: MaxLenError
methods.description: Returns an error message for strings exceeding maximum length.

methods.name: RegexError
methods.description: Returns an error message for regex validation failures.

methods.name: EmptyError
methods.description: Returns an error message for empty string validation failure.

methods.name: InclusiveRangeError
methods.description: Returns an error message for numeric range validation failure.

methods.name: hasChDirPrefix
methods.description: Checks for invalid directory prefix patterns in strings.

methods.name: IsValidSocketAddr
methods.description: Validates if a string is a valid socket address with IP and port.
